brief.title: Check the gift list against donors' privacy choices
brief.plain_summary: Check every coded gift row for its anonymous, mail and listing choices with the read-only tool, and hold rows with a missing choice or with goods given in return.
brief.outcome: A privacy check that lists held rows, anonymous rows and no-mail rows by gift code.

gift_list.description: Pin of a noun holding coded gift rows: gift code, date, amount, program and privacy choices, with no names or addresses.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.privacy-check's schema.
Every row missing any choice appears in held_rows.
Every row with goods_or_services_value above zero appears in held_rows.
The output holds no names, phone numbers, email addresses, street addresses or case details.

required: Check every row for an anonymous choice, a mail choice and a listing choice.
Hold every row with a missing choice, and every row with goods or services given in return, for a person.

Report gift codes and counts only.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
